name: Death Dog

source.note: The 2024 Death Dog (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block). The Bite's first failure (Poisoned) is entered; the later hit-point-maximum loss is a rider the engine does not run.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: A festering bite; a failed DC 12 Con save poisons the target, and later failures shrink its maximum Hit Points.
actions.text: Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. Constitution saving throw, DC 12. First failure: Poisoned; while Poisoned this way the target's Hit Point maximum doesn't return to normal after a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours, ending the effect on a success. Later failures: the Poisoned target's Hit Point maximum drops by 5 (1d10).

summary: A two-headed hound whose bites poison and whittle away a victim's maximum Hit Points.
